new_code_triggers.rule: OCFA SFR form: a new single-family residence needs an OCFA PR160 Residential Site (with Water Availability) review and PR400-402 fire sprinkler plans. PR160 is also triggered if the most remote portion of an ADU or detached structure is more than 140 ft from the fire access roadway, or total area exceeds 3,600 sf (non-sprinklered) / 6,200 sf (sprinklered) counting garages and detached structures within 10 ft. PR160 needs OCFA approval before the grading/building permit; sprinkler plans may be deferred.
new_code_triggers.applies_when: New SFR, or SFR + ADU where the ADU is far from the fire access road or total area is large.
new_code_triggers.required_evidence_on_plans: Site plan with fire access roadway and hose-pull distance to the farthest point of each building; total area tabulation incl. garages; OCFA SFR form answered; sprinkler note (deferred).

source.title: OCFA Plan Submittal Criteria Form - SFR (in Irvine ADU Application Package 2025)

new_code_triggers.rule: Irvine ADU checklist: show minimum 4-ft side and rear setbacks and a 6-ft building-to-building setback; mechanical equipment set back 2 ft from the property line and screened from off-site views.
new_code_triggers.applies_when: Detached ADU on the same lot as the new SFR.
new_code_triggers.required_evidence_on_plans: Site plan dimensions: ADU to side/rear property lines (>= 4 ft shown), ADU to primary dwelling (6 ft), mechanical equipment to property line (2 ft).

source.title: City of Irvine - Pre-Approved ADU Development Standards Checklist (Form 67-01 rev 01/25)

new_code_triggers.rule: Irvine ADU checklist: one parking space is required for an ADU with one or more bedrooms, in addition to the primary residence's required parking. State law exempts ADUs from parking in listed cases (Gov. Code 66322(a)), including an ADU permit submitted together with a new single-family dwelling permit where the ADU or parcel meets one of the other 66322(a)(1)-(5) criteria (e.g. within 1/2 mile walking distance of public transit).
new_code_triggers.applies_when: SFR + ADU with 1+ bedroom ADU, unless a 66322(a) exemption applies.
new_code_triggers.required_evidence_on_plans: Dimensioned and labeled ADU parking space (tandem on driveway allowed), or a note citing the 66322(a) exemption (e.g. transit distance).

source.title: City of Irvine Form 67-01; HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026) Parking Requirements

new_code_triggers.rule: A building with residential (R-2) and commercial (B or M) occupancies must be designed under CBC 508 as accessory, nonseparated or separated occupancies. Nonseparated: most restrictive Chapter 9 provisions apply to the whole nonseparated area and no occupancy separation is required, but R-2/R-3 dwelling units must still be separated from other units and from contiguous occupancies per Section 420 (508.3.3). Separated: each occupancy is separated per Table 508.4 with fire barriers (707) and/or horizontal assemblies (711) (508.4.4, 508.4.4.1).
new_code_triggers.applies_when: Any mixed-use building with dwelling units and commercial space.
new_code_triggers.required_evidence_on_plans: Code analysis stating the 508 method used, occupancy of each area, separation ratings, and fire barrier / horizontal assembly details between dwelling units and commercial space.

new_code_triggers.applies_when: Mixed-use building submitted through the commercial new-construction packet.
new_code_triggers.required_evidence_on_plans: Those notes/sheets in the plan set; grading plan check number if grading was submitted first.

new_state_law.rule: ADUs and JADUs must be approved or denied ministerially, without discretionary review or a hearing, against objective standards only.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: A permitting agency may concurrently approve or deny an ADU (and a JADU) submitted together with a new single-family dwelling; the ADU application is still considered without discretionary review or hearing. The 60-day approve/deny clock in 66317(a)(3) applies when there is an existing dwelling on the lot.
new_state_law.unit: days to approve or deny (existing dwelling on lot)
new_state_law.applies_when: SFR + ADU submitted together (new SFR is not yet an existing dwelling, so the 60-day clock may not run until the SFR is approved).

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: Summary of Recent Changes - Permitting Process / Concurrent Permitting; Gov. Code 66317(a)(3), 66335(a)(3)

new_state_law.rule: The permitting agency must determine whether an ADU/JADU application is complete and give written notice within 15 business days of receipt; an incomplete notice must list the missing items and how to fix them. An appeal process is required, with a final written determination within 60 business days of the appeal.
new_state_law.applies_when: ADU/JADU application submitted (Irvine states it checks completeness in about 2 business days).

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: If an ADU/JADU application is denied, the agency must return in writing a full set of comments listing defective items and how to remedy them within 60 days of receiving a complete application.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: A city may require no more than 4 ft side and rear setbacks for an attached or detached ADU. No setback for an ADU in an existing structure or rebuilt in the same location and dimensions.
new_state_law.applies_when: Attached or detached ADU; a plan showing more than 4 ft is fine.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: Lot coverage, FAR, open space, front setback, minimum lot size and size-percentage limits cannot preclude an ADU of at least 800 sf of interior livable space with 4-ft side and rear setbacks. No minimum lot size may be imposed for ADUs.
new_state_law.applies_when: ADU that would otherwise exceed local coverage/FAR/front setback limits.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: Zoning & Setbacks; Size FAQ; Gov. Code 66321(b)(3), 66314(b)(1)

new_state_law.rule: A local maximum ADU size must allow at least 850 sf of interior livable space, or 1,000 sf for an ADU with more than one bedroom.
new_state_law.unit: sq ft (1,000 if more than one bedroom)
new_state_law.applies_when: City has a compliant ADU ordinance with a max size.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: Without a compliant local ordinance: max 1,200 sf interior livable space for a new detached ADU; attached ADU up to 50% of the existing primary dwelling floor area (but at least 800 sf allowed). Irvine's ADU checklist uses detached up to 1,200 sf and attached up to 1,200 sf or 50% of primary, whichever is less.
new_state_law.applies_when: Irvine (Housing Element says Irvine defers to current State ADU law).

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026); City of Irvine Form 67-01

new_state_law.rule: A local minimum size may not prohibit an efficiency unit (Health and Safety Code 17958.1), which may be as small as 150 sf of floor area.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: A city may not set a detached ADU height limit below 16 ft on a lot with a proposed or existing single-family or multifamily dwelling.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: Detached ADU height floor rises to 18 ft when the lot is within 1/2 mile walking distance of a major transit stop or high-quality transit corridor, plus 2 more ft to match the primary dwelling's roof pitch.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: Attached ADU: a city may not set a limit below 25 ft or the primary dwelling's zoning height limit, whichever is lower; must allow at least two stories if within the height limit and building code. Not required to allow more than two stories.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: ADU parking may not exceed one space per unit or per bedroom, whichever is less; may be tandem on a driveway; no guest parking; no replacement parking when a garage/carport is demolished or converted for the ADU.
new_state_law.unit: space per ADU or per bedroom (max)

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: No ADU parking may be required if the ADU is: within 1/2 mile walking distance of public transit; in an architecturally and historically significant district; part of the proposed or existing primary residence or an accessory structure; where on-street permits are required but not offered to the ADU occupant; within one block of a car-share vehicle; or submitted with a permit for a new single-family or multifamily dwelling on the same lot when the ADU or parcel meets one of the other criteria.
new_state_law.unit: mile walking distance to public transit

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: No owner-occupancy requirement and no affordability deed restriction may be imposed on an ADU (except an ADU sold separately under 66341(c)(3)); a city may require rentals of 30 days or longer.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: Owner-Occupancy and Deed Restrictions FAQ; Gov. Code 66315

new_state_law.rule: A JADU is no more than 500 sf of interior livable space, contained entirely within a single-family residence (attached garage counts); not allowed in detached accessory structures; one JADU per lot zoned single-family; may have its own or shared sanitation; needs an efficiency kitchen. A JADU without its own bathroom needs a separate entrance plus an interior entry to the main living area.
new_state_law.applies_when: SFR + ADU project that includes a JADU.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: If a JADU shares sanitation with the primary dwelling, owner-occupancy is required (owner lives in the main house or the JADU); not required if the JADU has its own sanitation. A JADU ordinance must require a recorded deed restriction prohibiting separate sale and restricting size/attributes. JADUs cannot be short-term rentals (rentals > 30 days).

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: Owner-Occupancy and Deed Restrictions FAQ; Gov. Code 66333(b), (c)(1)-(2), (g)

new_state_law.rule: On a lot with a proposed or existing single-family dwelling, the city must allow (as 66323 Units, no local standards beyond 66323): one ADU within existing/proposed space, one JADU, and one new detached ADU of up to 800 sf interior livable space with 4-ft side and rear setbacks (height per 66321(b)(4)); no parking may be required for 66323 Units. Separately, at least one 66314 ADU must be allowed.
new_state_law.applies_when: SFR + ADU where the ADU is claimed under 66323.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: 66323 Units FAQ and 'Allowable 66323 ADU Combinations' table; Gov. Code 66323(a)(1)-(2), (b)

new_state_law.rule: Fire sprinklers are required in an ADU/JADU only if required for the primary residence, and an ADU/JADU cannot trigger sprinklers in the primary residence. A new SFR in Irvine is sprinklered (local amendment / CRC R309), so an ADU built with it should expect sprinklers (OCFA SFR form Q2 routes it to PR400-402).

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

new_state_law.rule: No impact fees on an ADU of 750 sf interior livable space or less (or a JADU of 500 sf or less); above 750 sf, impact fees must be proportional to the primary dwelling's square footage. Utilities may treat an ADU as a new residential use for connection/capacity fees when it is built concurrently with a new single-family home. Irvine Form 42-97 lists 'ADU is 749 sq. ft. or less' as a school-fee exemption.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026); Irvine Form 42-97 (ADU package)

new_state_law.rule: Construction of an ADU does not constitute a Group R occupancy change under the local building code unless the city makes a written finding of a specific adverse health/safety impact.
new_state_law.applies_when: ADU attached to or near the SFR.

source.title: HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)
source.section: Summary of Recent Changes - Occupancy Change; Gov. Code 66314(d)(8)

new_state_law.rule: AB 2011 (Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act, Gov. Code 65912.100-65912.140) creates an optional streamlined, ministerial, CEQA-exempt review for multifamily housing on sites that allow commercial uses (office, retail, parking). Two pathways: 100% affordable lower-income, or mixed-income with specified affordability. Requires prevailing wage; 50+ units also need apprenticeship access and healthcare expenditures. Cities may exempt and replace parcels with no-net-loss findings. Effective July 1, 2023 until January 1, 2033. Amended by AB 2243 (2024) and AB 893 (2025).
new_state_law.applies_when: Applicant claims AB 2011 for residential or mixed-use on commercially zoned land.

source.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheet - AB 2011 (April 2026)

new_state_law.rule: AB 2011 site eligibility, density, height, setback and affordability percentages.

new_zoning_districts.name: Trails and Transit-Oriented Development (Orange County Great Park); 8.1, 8.1B

source.title: Irvine 2021-2029 Housing Element Ch. 5, Tables 5-3 and 5-4; Orange County Great Park section

new_zoning_districts.note: Great Park land use 5-50 du/ac; mix of residential (attached and detached), commercial, institutional, industrial, educational. Min lot 2,400 sf or 0.25 acre (all other uses); front 8-45, side 5, rear 10, bldg-to-bldg 6 ft. Coverage 50% SFD, 65% nonresidential and mixed use (unlimited in 8.1B), unlimited attached residential. Height SFD 35 ft; residential attached and nonresidential 70 ft (text also says 55-70 ft). Master Plan required for residential uses. Ordinance text not read.

sfr.note: Detached one-family dwelling not more than 3 stories above grade plane is within CRC scope (R101.2). Over 3 stories it goes to the CBC as R-3 (310.4: not more than two dwelling units); use the R-3 allowable rows. Sprinklers per CRC R309 (NFPA 13D or R309.3).

source.title: 2025 California Residential Code (Title 24 Part 2.5), UpCodes

sfr_adu.note: The ADU is its own dwelling unit. Detached ADU = a second detached one-family dwelling on the lot (fire separation distance to the house measured to an imaginary line, R302.1). Attached ADU = the building has two dwelling units, so the unit separation of CRC R302.3 (1 hour, or 1/2 hour when sprinklered per R309) applies; this classification is an inference from the code text, and Gov. Code 66314(d)(8) says an ADU is not a Group R occupancy change. A JADU is within the SFR and is not treated as a separate dwelling unit here (not confirmed in code text).

source.title: 2025 California Residential Code (Title 24 Part 2.5), UpCodes; HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026)

mixed_use.note: Residential portion with more than two dwelling units is R-2 (310.3); the commercial portion is typically B (office/service) or M (retail) - each portion is classified individually (508.1) and designed as accessory, nonseparated or separated occupancies under 508. With separated occupancies, Table 508.4 requires 1 hour between R-2 and B/M in a building sprinklered per 903.3.1.1 (NFPA 13), 2 hours otherwise. Each occupancy must stay within its own height/story limits (504.2), so check the B/M rows too (not stored in this file). A mixed-use building with 1-2 units would be R-3 under the CBC (not modeled).

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes

new_construction_requirements.rule: Separated occupancies (Table 508.4): R-2 to B, F-1, M or S-1 = 1 hour in a building sprinklered throughout per 903.3.1.1 (NFPA 13), 2 hours if not. R row carries footnote a (see Section 420). Separations are fire barriers (707) and/or horizontal assemblies (711) that completely separate the occupancies. An NFPA 13R system does not count as 'S' for this table.
new_construction_requirements.required_evidence_on_plans: Code analysis naming 'separated occupancies'; floor/wall legend with listed 1-hour (NFPA 13) or 2-hour assemblies between residential and commercial; podium slab/horizontal assembly detail; sprinkler type stated on title sheet.

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes

new_construction_requirements.rule: Separated occupancies (Table 508.4): R-2 to F-2, S-2 (e.g. parking garage) or U = 1 hour sprinklered (903.3.1.1) / 2 hours not, with footnote c (see 406.3.2 and 406.6.4). Footnote b on S-2: separation from areas used only for private or pleasure vehicles may be reduced by 1 hour but not below 1 hour.
new_construction_requirements.required_evidence_on_plans: Rated separation between garage/parking level and dwellings; parking use noted.

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes
source.section: Table 508.4 (R row x F-2/S-2/U column), footnotes b, c

new_construction_requirements.rule: Nonseparated occupancies: no separation between the occupancies is required, but the most restrictive Chapter 9 provisions apply to the total nonseparated area, and R-2/R-3 dwelling units must still be separated from other units and from other contiguous occupancies per Section 420 (508.3.3 exception).
new_construction_requirements.required_evidence_on_plans: Code analysis naming 'nonseparated occupancies'; height/area checked against the most restrictive occupancy; Section 420 unit separations (1-hour fire partitions/horizontal assemblies) between dwelling units and commercial space.

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes

new_construction_requirements.rule: Accessory occupancies: aggregate accessory occupancies may not occupy more than 10 percent of the floor area of the story they are on (and each is limited to the nonsprinklered Table 506.2 area for that occupancy). A commercial space larger than this is not 'accessory' and must use 508.3 or 508.4.
new_construction_requirements.required_evidence_on_plans: Area tabulation per story showing commercial area as a percent of the story if the accessory method is claimed.

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes

new_construction_requirements.rule: An attached ADU makes the building a two-family dwelling: the units must be separated by 1-hour fire-resistance-rated wall and/or floor assemblies, or 1/2 hour when sprinklered throughout per CRC R309 (NFPA 13D or R309.3), continuous to the foundation and roof sheathing. Applying R302.3 to an attached ADU is an inference from the code text, not stated by Irvine.
new_construction_requirements.required_evidence_on_plans: Plans/sections tagging the wall or floor between the house and attached ADU with a listed assembly and rating; continuity detail; sprinkler note if 1/2 hour is used.

source.title: 2025 California Residential Code (Title 24 Part 2.5), UpCodes
